PLAN:
## Execution Plan

[FAST_PATH] — All 18 existing tests pass. The illegal-move silent-rejection behavior is already **fully verified**.

---

### Summary

The test suite `src/engine/__tests__/illegalMoveRejection.test.ts` already comprehensively covers this requirement. All **18 tests pass** with 0 failures.

### How the engine enforces silent rejection

| Layer | File | Mechanism |
|---|---|---|
| **Move execution** | `src/engine/index.ts` → `makeMove()` | Returns `{ valid: false }` (no `newState`, no `captured`) for any illegal move — never throws. Two guard checks: (1) piece must exist and belong to `currentPlayer`, (2) destination must be in the legal-moves list. |
| **Legal move generation** | `src/engine/specialRules.ts` → `getLegalMoves()` | Filters `getRawMoves()` to exclude moves that leave own general in check (`isInCheck`) or create a flying-general violation (`isFlyingGeneral`). |
| **Raw move generation** | `src/engine/moveValidation.ts` → `getRawMoves()` | Per-piece rules (chariot line-of-sight, knight leg-block, elephant eye/river, advisor palace, general palace, cannon screen, soldier forward/sideways). Out-of-bounds moves are never generated. |
| **Check detection** | `src/engine/checkDetection.ts` | Combines standard attack detection (`isSquareAttackedBy`) with flying-general detection. |
| **Immutable state** | `src/engine/specialRules.ts` → `applyMove()` | Creates a deep copy of the board; the original `Board` type is `ReadonlyArray<ReadonlyArray<Piece | null>>`. |

### What the 18 tests verify

| # | Scenario | Key assertion |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Moving an empty square | `valid: false`, no `newState` |
| 2 | Moving opponent's piece | `valid: false`, no `newState` |
| 3 | Chariot diagonal (invalid) | `valid: false`, no `newState` |
| 4 | General out of palace | `valid: false`, no `newState` |
| 5 | Knight non-L-shape | `valid: false`, no `newState` |
| 6 | Move leaves own general in check | `valid: false`, no `newState` |
| 7 | Flying general violation | `valid: false`, no `newState` |
| 8 | Move onto own piece | `valid: false`, no `newState` |
| 9 | Elephant crosses river | `valid: false`, no `newState` |
| 10 | Advisor leaves palace | `valid: false`, no `newState` |
| 11 | Soldier moves backward | `valid: false`, no `newState` |
| 12 | Cannon captures without screen | `valid: false`, no `newState` |
| 13 | Out-of-bounds destination (row 10) | `valid: false`, no `newState` |
| 14 | Out-of-bounds source (row -1) | `valid: false`, no `newState` |
| 15 | **No mutation** after multiple illegal moves | `state.board` reference unchanged, pieces still in place, `currentPlayer` still `'red'` |
| 16 | **No exception** for 9 different illegal moves | `expect(() => makeMove(...)).not.toThrow()` + `valid: false` |
| 17 | Same source & destination | `valid: false`, no `newState` |
| 18 | Wrong player's turn after a valid move | `valid: false`, no `newState`, prior state unmodified |

### Conclusion

**No code changes are needed.** The existing implementation and test suite already fully verify that illegal moves are silently rejected (no state change, no error thrown). All 18 tests pass in 351ms.

## Test Report: Illegal moves are silently rejected (no state change, no error)

### Commands Run

| Command | Outcome |
|---|---|
| `npx vitest run src/engine/__tests__/illegalMoveRejection.test.ts` | ✅ **18/18 passed** (358ms) |
| `npx vitest run src/engine/__tests__/` | ✅ **172/172 passed** (all engine tests, 1.01s) |

### What Was Verified

The dedicated test file `src/engine/__tests__/illegalMoveRejection.test.ts` covers **18 scenarios** that collectively verify the core requirement: **illegal moves are silently rejected — no state mutation, no thrown exception.**

| # | Test Scenario | Verified |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Move from empty square | `valid: false`, no `newState`, no error |
| 2 | Move opponent's piece | `valid: false`, no `newState`, no error |
| 3 | Chariot diagonal (illegal) | `valid: false`, no `newState`, no error |
| 4 | General out of palace | `valid: false`, no `newState`, no error |
| 5 | Knight non-L-shape | `valid: false`, no `newState`, no error |
| 6 | Move leaves own general in check | `valid: false`, no `newState`, no error |
| 7 | Flying general violation | `valid: false`, no `newState`, no error |
| 8 | Move onto own piece | `valid: false`, no `newState`, no error |
| 9 | Elephant crosses river | `valid: false`, no `newState`, no error |
| 10 | Advisor leaves palace | `valid: false`, no `newState`, no error |
| 11 | Soldier moves backward | `valid: false`, no `newState`, no error |
| 12 | Cannon captures without screen | `valid: false`, no `newState`, no error |
| 13 | Out-of-bounds destination (row 10) | `valid: false`, no `newState`, no error |
| 14 | Out-of-bounds source (row -1) | `valid: false`, no `newState`, no error |
| 15 | **No mutation** after 3 illegal moves | Board reference unchanged, pieces intact, `currentPlayer` unchanged |
| 16 | **No exception** for 9 different illegal moves | `expect(() => makeMove(...)).not.toThrow()` + `valid: false` for each |
| 17 | Same source & destination | `valid: false`, no `newState`, no error |
| 18 | Wrong player's turn after valid move | `valid: false`, no `newState`, prior state unmodified |

### Implementation Verification

- **`makeMove()`** in `src/engine/index.ts` returns `{ valid: false }` for any illegal move — it **never throws**. Two guard clauses: (1) piece existence + ownership check, (2) destination legality check.
- **`MoveResult`** type correctly uses `valid: false` with optional `newState`/`captured` (both `undefined` on rejection).
- **`Board`** type is `ReadonlyArray<ReadonlyArray<Piece | null>>` — immutability enforced at the type level.
- The only `throw` in the engine (`findGeneralPosition`) is unreachable during normal `makeMove` flow since illegal moves are rejected before general lookup is needed for check validation.

### Note on Unrelated Failures

2 tests in `src/hooks/` fail (`debug-capture.test.ts`, `useGameState.test.ts`) — these are about **captured piece tracking in the React hook layer**, unrelated to the illegal move rejection task. All engine-layer tests pass.

### Conclusion

The implementation correctly and silently rejects all illegal moves. No state change occurs, and no errors are thrown.

**PASS**
